DEFINE INSTRUMENT pinhole_sans (
lambda0 = 6.0, // Angs] central wavelength

AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT source_ap_mon = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 100, ny = 100,

AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.001) RELATIVE source

COMPONENT sample_ap = Slit(

AT (0.0, 0.0, L1) RELATIVE source

 yheight = 2*R2*1.5, restore_neutron = 1)

 yheight = 0.01, zdepth = 0.005,
 target_index = 2, focus_xw = 0.6,
 focus_yh = 0.6)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.001) RELATIVE sample_ap

 nx = 200, ny = 200,

AT (0.0, 0.0, L2) RELATIVE sample

 xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.02,

 yheight = 0.6, restore_neutron = 1)

AT (0.0, 0.0, L2) RELATIVE sample

 xwidth = 0.6, yheight = 0.6,
